items.prompt: Some universities require every student to take at least one course outside their own discipline. Write an essay discussing whether this requirement benefits students, and support your view with reasons and examples.
suggestedStructure: 改写题目并明确本文的核心论点
第一段论证：跨学科课程如何改善思维方式
第二段论证：跨学科课程如何影响就业与协作能力
让步段：承认时间成本或课程质量的问题并回应
结论段：重申论点并指出实施的关键条件

advancedPatterns.name: 名词化主语
advancedPatterns.template: The + 名词化 + of ... + 谓语
advancedPatterns.sample: The integration of statistics into a history degree sharpens evidential reasoning.

advancedPatterns.name: not merely ... but rather ...
advancedPatterns.template: not merely + A + but rather + B
advancedPatterns.sample: Universities should aim not merely at employability but rather at intellectual flexibility.

advancedPatterns.name: 倒装强调
advancedPatterns.sample: Only when students leave their comfort zone do they notice the limits of their own field.

paragraphs.en: A growing number of universities now oblige undergraduates to study at least one module beyond their major. I believe this requirement is justified, provided that the extra module is properly designed.
paragraphs.cn: 越来越多的大学要求本科生至少修一门专业以外的课程。我认为只要这门课设计得当，这一要求就是合理的。
paragraphs.note: 开头改写题目并给出带条件的立场。

paragraphs.en: Firstly, cross-disciplinary study reshapes how students reason. The integration of statistics into a history degree, for instance, forces a student to ask how reliable a source really is rather than accepting a narrative.
paragraphs.cn: 首先，跨学科学习重塑学生的推理方式。例如把统计学引入历史学位，会迫使学生追问史料到底有多可靠，而不是接受既有叙事。
paragraphs.note: 名词化主语 + 具体案例。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, employers increasingly value graduates who can talk across professional boundaries. Only when students leave their comfort zone do they learn the vocabulary of another field.
paragraphs.cn: 其次，雇主越来越看重能跨专业沟通的毕业生。只有当学生走出舒适区，才会学到另一个领域的话语体系。

paragraphs.en: Admittedly, poorly taught elective courses can waste time. Consequently, the value of the policy depends on whether departments design genuine introductory pathways rather than diluted lectures.
paragraphs.cn: 诚然，教学质量差的选修课会浪费时间。因此该政策的价值取决于院系是否设计了真正的入门路径，而非注水课程。
paragraphs.note: 让步不空泛，指向落地条件。

paragraphs.en: In summary, compulsory cross-disciplinary study is worthwhile, because it aims not merely at employability but rather at intellectual flexibility.
paragraphs.cn: 总之，强制性跨学科学习是值得的，因为它追求的不只是就业力，而是思维的灵活性。
paragraphs.note: 结尾复用 not merely ... but rather 句式。

items.prompt: Remote internships have become common. Write an essay explaining the main advantages and drawbacks of remote internships for university students, and state which format you would choose.
suggestedStructure: 交代远程实习兴起的背景
论述远程实习的主要优势
论述远程实习的主要不足
比较两者对不同专业学生的影响差异
给出个人选择及其理由

advancedPatterns.name: whereas 对比
advancedPatterns.sample: Remote roles remove commuting costs, whereas on-site roles offer incidental learning.

advancedPatterns.name: 定语从句 + which
advancedPatterns.sample: Interns miss corridor conversations, which often reveal how decisions are really made.

items.prompt: Your university library plans to replace half of its printed collection with digital resources. Write a report to the library committee evaluating this plan and making two recommendations.
suggestedStructure: 说明报告目的与评估范围
陈述该计划的可预期收益（成本、可达性）
陈述该计划的风险（阅读体验、特殊学科需求）
提出第一条可执行建议
提出第二条可执行建议并说明评估指标

advancedPatterns.name: 正式建议句
advancedPatterns.template: It is recommended that + 主语 + (should) + 动词原形
advancedPatterns.sample: It is recommended that the committee run a one-year pilot in two departments.

advancedPatterns.name: 数据表述
advancedPatterns.sample: Approximately 40 per cent of borrowings come from three subject areas.
